algorithmProof.boundedPotential: Each output is saturate(current + (weightedAverage(saturate(neighbor)) - current) * saturate(gain)); nonnegative conductance and clamp force [0,1].
algorithmProof.noDivergence: There is no convergence loop; exactly two passes execute, then the frame terminates.
algorithmProof.noOscillationAmplification: Any frame-to-frame change is bounded by 1.0 because all stored potentials are clamped.
algorithmProof.shortCircuitHandling: Short-circuit edges are skipped from conductance accumulation; zero conductance cannot divide because conductanceSum <= epsilon falls back to current.

blackoutFastPath.subMicrosecondClaim: valid only for latched unchanged idle blackout/open-circuit frames; first transition is O(nodes+edges)

honesty: A full 2000-node/6000-edge active solve is bounded, but not sub-microsecond on weak hardware. Sub-microsecond applies only to latched idle fast-path frames with zero CSR touches.
